headline: Marketing and Community Engagement Consultant
summary: Audience-focused communications professional with 10+ years of hands-on experience across email, digital content and event marketing. Skilled at turning a busy calendar into clear, timely campaigns, tailoring messages for distinct audiences and catching small errors before they become public ones. Brings strong editorial judgment, dependable follow-through, hands-on administrative experience, and openness to short-term or project-based assignments.
